findings.title: MR3 shock filter silently requires 6 full prior in-session bars; stated rule ("some bar among the 6 before had |E| < 1") would pass early-session shocks, code blocks them
findings.where: /home/dustin/Projects/strategy-lab/src/stratlab/strategies/vwap_mean_reversion.py:48-53 (`rolling(shock_lookback, min_periods=shock_lookback)`), vs /home/dustin/Projects/strategy-lab/studies/vwap-mr-2026-10/manifests/VMRL_FAMILY_PROPOSAL_v0.1.md MR3 row and VMRL_EXPERIMENT_v0.1.toml MR3 `difference`
findings.evidence: Window alignment itself is correct (verified by hand: minabsE_before_prev at decision bar t equals min|E| over t-7..t-2; minabsE_before_cur equals t-6..t-1). But with min_periods=6 the feature is NaN whenever the extended bar t-1 has fewer than 6 in-session predecessors, and `not (nan < 1.0)` blocks the entry. For decision bars ending 10:00 and 10:05 ET (inside the declared window) MR3 therefore never fires regardless of shock. Synthetic probe (scratch review4-fable/probe.py): plunge at 09:50, failed extension 09:55-10:00 -> MR0 enters 10:00; MR3 blocked (minabsE_before_prev = nan, E_prev = -7.12) and instead entered 10:10 on a later recovery bar. Under the proposal's wording the 09:30 bar has |E| ~ 0 so this displacement 'arrived quickly from near VWAP' and should pass. MR3's 'trades differ from MR0' count will mix shock/non-shock with this time-of-day artefact.
findings.fix: Decide before freeze and write it down in the proposal and TOML `difference`: either (a) keep min_periods=6 and state 'the extended bar must have at least 6 completed in-session bars before it; MR3 cannot fire for bars ending before 10:10', or (b) use min_periods=1 (any available prior bars) so the rule matches the prose. Add a synthetic test pinning whichever is chosen.

findings.title: Test suite covers longs only: short mirror, 5 bps stop floor, and extension_only+shock_filter are untested while the proposal says 'implemented and tested'
findings.evidence: No test asserts a short entry, short stop (max(high_t, high_{t-1}) + tick), short half_target, or the `c - floor` branch of the stop. My synthetic probe confirms the code is correct: spike to 102 then lower-high/lower-close -> short entry 10:40 @ 101.70, stop 102.06 = max(102.00,102.05)+0.01, exit vwap_reached; half_target 100.97 matches round(c+0.5*(v-c),2); 'still extending' (higher high) correctly produces no 10:40 entry; floor branch picks the further of (low-tick, c-5bps). So this is a coverage gap, not a behaviour defect, but half of every variant's trades are shorts.
findings.fix: Add mirrored short tests (entry, stop, half_target, still-extending), one stop-floor test where c - 5bps is below the extreme-based stop, and one failed_extension+shock/extension_only+shock short case.

findings.title: K = 4.0 derivation does not state that the quantile population is exactly the population that will be scored
findings.evidence: excursion_quantiles.py uses warmup=5, bars ending 10:00-15:00 inclusive, complete bars, all sessions of the dataset -- the same scored sessions, window and feature code (mr_features defaults) the experiment will score. The fresh-capture quantile (P90 = 3.94) was computed on the recommended run dataset over its full history, including the 'latest 6 months' window. That is honest (no P&L, no strategy) but it is in-sample on the scoring population, unlike the August charter's K, which was a P90 on a development window with a holdout untouched. The proposal says 'trade-blind' and 'nothing here is a holdout' but never says 'K was set from the same bars that will be scored'. August thresholds were NOT silently revived (4.0 vs 4.09, noted explicitly; |E|<1.0 and 6-bar lookback are new lab choices).
findings.fix: Add one sentence: 'The |E| quantiles were computed on the full scored population of the run dataset; K is trade-blind but not out-of-sample.' Optionally also report the quantile on the first calendar half alone so the reviewer can see stability.

findings.title: Competing explanation (2) 'volatility scaling' is untestable from the declared variants and saved outputs; enter() metadata E_signal/k is not persisted
findings.where: /home/dustin/Projects/strategy-lab/studies/vwap-mr-2026-10/manifests/VMRL_FAMILY_PROPOSAL_v0.1.md 'Competing explanation' row; /home/dustin/Projects/strategy-lab/src/stratlab/strategies/vwap_mean_reversion.py:134 (`E_signal=..., k=...`); /home/dustin/Projects/strategy-lab/src/stratlab/engine.py:356-369 (row builder exports a fixed field list)
findings.evidence: The proposal lists three competing explanations but only (3) has a variant (MR3). (1) trend days is only indirectly touched by MR3; (2) ATR-denominator scaling has no variant and no pre-committed diagnostic. The synthetic probe shows (2) is real: in a flat tail the 5m ATR collapses and E <= -3 fires on a 0.2-point move (extension_only produced two long entries at 11:40/11:45 on 99.80 flat bars). The strategy passes E_signal and k into enter(), but _closed_trade_rows/_open_trade_rows copy only named meta keys, so E_signal (and ATR at signal, which is not passed at all) never reach trades.csv/metrics -- a post-run slice by ATR or |E| quantile cannot be done from saved outputs. The uninformative-if gates themselves ARE computable: diff_vs_baseline has added/removed/altered and r_removed; metrics has ambiguous_stop_target_minutes and t_stat_r.
findings.fix: Either state explicitly that (1) and (2) are not tested by this experiment, or pre-commit a post-run diagnostic (expectancy R by ATR-at-signal tercile) and persist atr_signal/E_signal into the trade rows (that is an engine change -- note it against the 'no engine changes' reuse claim, or pass them through a generic meta passthrough).

findings.title: Re-entry behaviour is undeclared: the failed-extension trigger re-fires on every up-close bar while E_{t-1} <= -K, so one displacement can produce several trades after stop-outs
findings.where: /home/dustin/Projects/strategy-lab/src/stratlab/strategies/vwap_mean_reversion.py:81-99 (_signal has no 'first failed extension' state); /home/dustin/Projects/strategy-lab/studies/vwap-mr-2026-10/manifests/VMRL_FAMILY_PROPOSAL_v0.1.md Baseline MR0 items 2 and 6
findings.evidence: Rule 2 as written (low_t > low_{t-1} and close_t > close_{t-1}) matches the code exactly, but during a slow drift back toward VWAP every bar satisfies it until E_{t-1} rises above -K. Probe: MR3 entered at 10:10 on the third recovery bar after being blocked at 10:00; extension_only re-entered at 11:45 one bar after an 11:40 stop-out. 'One position at a time' only prevents overlap; nothing prevents immediate re-entry on the same displacement. The narrative ('a failed extension after a large displacement') and the 200/100-trade gates read as one trade per displacement.
findings.fix: Add a sentence to MR0 rule 6: 'A new entry may be taken on the first qualifying bar after any exit, including on the same displacement; no cooldown.' If a cooldown is wanted it must be declared now, before any run, not added as a rescue.

findings.title: Exit wording 'first later completed bar' vs code evaluating exits on bars with missing minutes
findings.evidence: on_signal_bar checks the vwap_close exit before `signal_bar_complete()`, so a 5m bar missing constituent minutes (masked print) can trigger the exit; only new entries are gated on completeness (engine convention, documented in engine.py:162-165). The proposal uses 'completed bar' for both the entry decision and the exit, which a reader may take to mean 'no missing minutes'. Entry window inclusivity (10:00 <= end <= 15:00), stop formula, half-target formula, shorts mirror, extension index (t-1 for failed_extension, t for extension_only), and causality (features published at the bar's last minute, shift/rolling backward only, VWAP cumulative) all match code and are causal.
findings.fix: Reword rule 5 to 'the first later signal bar (complete or not) whose close is at or through VWAP' or state the engine convention once in item 6.

verdicts.title: MR3 shock filter silently requires 6 full prior in-session bars; stated rule ("some bar among the 6 before had |E| < 1") would pass early-session shocks, code blocks them
verdicts.reasoning: CONFIRMED. vwap_mean_reversion.py lines 51-55 (not 48-53) use rolling(shock_lookback, min_periods=shock_lookback) on shift(2)/shift(1) grouped by session, and line 103 `not (shock_ref < shock_near)` returns None on NaN. Independent synthetic probe: plunge 09:50, failed extension 09:55 -> MR0 enters 10:00 (stop 97.94); MR3 blocked (minabsE_before_prev = nan, E_prev = -7.12, |E| at 09:30 bar = 0.0) and instead entered 10:10 on a recovery bar. Shock with extended bar starting 09:55 (5 prior bars) also blocked (nan); extended bar starting 10:00 (6 prior bars) passes (minabsE=0.0, entry 10:10). So MR3 cannot fire for decision bars ending 10:00 or 10:05 regardless of shock, while the proposal/TOML wording ('some bar among the 6 before') implies it would. Definition/code mismatch in a pre-freeze spec affecting one variant: major stands.

findings.title: Fresh-extension inherits trade-count gates that 38 sessions almost certainly cannot meet
findings.evidence: Scored window verified via the data layer: 463 sessions before 2026-08-24, 38 from 2026-08-24..2026-10-15, build_windows(cov,463,0,False) -> single 'full' window 2026-08-24..2026-10-15, 38 sessions. The variants are byte-identical to VWR0_EXPERIMENT_v1.1 (only [windows] differs), so the gates are carried over unchanged: VWR0 'fewer than 200 closed trades' and VWR1-4/IGP0 'fewer than 100'. Pro-rating VWR0-EXP's recorded counts (2,428/489 sessions etc.) gives ~189 VWR0, ~72 VWR2, ~107 VWR4, ~99 IGP0 trades on 38 sessions, so most arms including the baseline would be pre-declared uninformative by the manifest's own rule. The limitations say 'small sample; a single look' but do not say the inherited gates are expected to fail or what the run is then for.
findings.fix: Before freezing as v1.0, add a dated limitation stating that the gates are inherited from v1.1, give the pro-rated expected trade counts, and state what the run can support (descriptive fresh-historical evidence on the same rules, pooled with or compared to the original window), or declare a smaller pre-registered gate for this extension in writing. Do not change the rules or variants.
